name: gpu-server-setup
description: Prepare a Linux server with NVIDIA GPUs for LLM and neural-network workloads: NVIDIA driver + CUDA from the official repo, Docker Engine + NVIDIA Container Toolkit as the mandatory base, GPU passthrough into containers, staged verification gates, optional docker-compose presets for vLLM, Infinity, OpenWebUI and Ollama (llama.cpp via its official image), and GPU power-limit setup persisted via systemd.
